name: Linework Hero
tagline: Draw your system as an animated isometric diagram with real labels and moving packets, made to be the hero of a page.
youSay: /linework-hero Draw my system: apps → collector → stream → warehouse → dashboard, as the hero of a blog post
whatYouGet: An animated isometric diagram of your system: correct labels, links that route themselves, packets, hover lifts and click-to-open layers
The page around it: a blog post that builds it as you scroll, a tracker, a shop or a product page that takes it apart
Fourteen looks (paper, blueprint, riso, neon, terminal, sage…) or one made from your brand's hue
Plain HTML and JS, or one self-contained file to publish or send
goodFit: Engineering blogs, docs and product pages that explain how something works
Exploded product views, process pages and interactive empty states
notFor: Huge diagrams with dozens of nodes (split them into two)
youBring: The system: its parts and how they connect (or the object)
Optional: where it will live, a look or a brand colour
